title: OBC v3 Off-Chain Envelope
description: Envelope of every v3 off-chain document. data is validated separately against the schema named in schema (see types.json), except for tombstones (status 'voided'). The schema id's <type> part must equal type. Unknown top-level fields are ignored.

version.description: Off-chain document version. Always 3 for this standard.

sourceModifiedAt.description: When the document last changed in the source system (ISO 8601 UTC).

data.description: Document content. Validated against schema unless status is voided, in which case it may be empty.

rel.description: source (this record was derived from the target), derived (the target was derived from this record), or another registered value.

type.description: The target's document type, as a hint.
